events.title: Google DeepMind launches institute to widen the AGI debate
events.summary: The new institute aims to surface differing views between Google, Google DeepMind, and the broader global research community around AGI. "They will not always agree, and they will likely change their minds, as more data and information comes to light at the fast-moving frontier."

events.title: Huawei plans Q1 2027 launch of new AI chip as it takes on Nvidia
events.summary: Huawei is accelerating the launch of its next-generation Ascend 960DT AI chip as it pushes to compete with Nvidia and close China’s AI computing gap with the U.S.

events.title: China's Huawei sets 2027 launch for new AI chips as it targets Nvidia
events.summary: The company is also working on ways to connect very large numbers of AI chips, allowing them to work together as one bigger computing system. Most advanced AI programmes require more processing power than a single chip can provide.

events.title: Snap targets enterprises with Salesforce, Nvidia AI tools for augmented-reality glasses
events.summary: Snap on Wednesday announced partnerships with companies including Salesforce, Nvidia and Amazon Web Services to integrate workplace tools into its Specs augmented-reality glasses, courting enterprise demand to carve a foothold in the heavily contested market.

events.title: Anthropic to fold Claude AI features into one interface, launches document tools
events.summary: Anthropic said on Wednesday it is combining the chat and Cowork features of its Claude AI assistant into a single interface and launching new document and presentation tools.
